issues: Relies on corepack network download to provision yarn 4.17.1 instead of installing yarn-berry from the catalog — offline/first-activate fragility
No exact version pins (nodejs.version/ruby.version) — pkg-path alone leaves patch level to the resolver, and .nvmrc pins 24.18

Hook and service commands use TOML basic multi-line strings (""") with backslash line continuations; TOML collapses those lines, which happens to work but is a subtle escaping landmine vs. literal ''' strings
Uses TCP (127.0.0.1) for both Postgres and Redis rather than unix sockets in /tmp — sane, but risks port collisions with a host Postgres/Redis

results.manifest_excerpt:
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

[install]
# Runtimes — versions pinned by .ruby-version, .nvmrc
ruby.pkg-path = "ruby_4_0"
# .nvmrc pins 24.18; the catalog's newest nodejs_24 available on every system
# (including x86_64-darwin) is 24.16.0. Satisfies package.json engines.node ">=22".
nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"

# Datastores — Mastodon's dev loop expects these locally
# (docker-compose.yml is production-only, by its own header comment)
# The "dev" output carries libpq-fe.h + pg_config, which the pg gem compiles against.
postgresql.pkg-path = "postgresql_14"
postgresql.outputs = ["out", "lib", "dev"]
redis.pkg-path = "redis"

# Media processing — declared in Aptfile/Dockerfile, never in the Gemfile.
# ruby-vips binds libvips through FFI at runtime, so the "out" output holding
# libvips.so is required — vips installs only "bin" and "man" by default.
vips.pkg-path = "vips"
vips.outputs = ["out", "bin", "dev"]
# Mastodon shells out to the ffmpeg CLI, so the default "bin" output suffices.
ffmpeg.pkg-path = "ffmpeg"

# Native gem build dependencies (Dockerfile ruby-build stage).
# Each needs its "dev" output for headers: nixpkgs splits those out, and they
# are not installed by default.
#   icu      -> charlock_holmes
#   libidn   -> idn-ruby (GNU libidn v1 — NOT libidn2)
#   libyaml  -> psych
#   openssl  -> hiredis-client
icu.pkg-path = "icu"
icu.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
libidn.pkg-path = "libidn"
libidn.outputs = ["out", "bin", "dev"]
gdbm.pkg-path = "gdbm"
gdbm.outputs = ["out", "lib", "dev"]
gmp.pkg-path = "gmp"
gmp.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
libyaml.pkg-path = "libyaml"
libyaml.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
openssl.pkg-path = "openssl"
openssl.outputs = ["out", "bin", "dev"]
zlib.pkg-path = "zlib"
zlib.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
shared-mime-info.pkg-path = "shared-mime-info"

# Build toolchain
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"
git.pkg-path = "git"

# Runs Procfile.dev (web + sidekiq + stream + vite), per .foreman
foreman.pkg-path = "foreman"

[vars]
# Matches config/database.yml development keys
DB_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
DB_PORT = "5432"
DB_USER = "mastodon"
DB_NAME = "mastodon_development"
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "mastodon"
REDIS_URL = "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0"
REDIS_PORT = "6379"
RAILS_ENV = "development"
# Silence Corepack's interactive download prompt, as .devcontainer does
COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT = "0"

[hook]
on-activate = """
  # --- Ruby: keep gems out of the read-only runtime and out of the repo ---
  export GEM_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/gems"
  export BUNDLE_PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/gems"
  export BUNDLE_APP_CONFIG="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/bundle"
  export PATH="$GEM_HOME/bin:$PATH"
  mkdir -p "$GEM_HOME" "$BUNDLE_APP_CONFIG"

  # --- Node: provision the exact pinned yarn (4.17.1) via corepack ---
  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  corepack enable --install-directory "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" yarn 2>/dev/nul
